subject: Working w/ SmartEye, Cipia & Toyota | [COMPANY] Autosense
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I noticed [COMPANY]'s recent focus on DMS - especially the EU homologation & large automotive contracts - so thought I'd reach out. I lead an automotive team here at Encord and we're working w/ a few of your peers (SmartEye, Toyota, Cipia, Nauto, Seeing Machines, etc) to develop new AI/CV products & scale use cases like driver behavior analytics, in-cabin monitoring, safety alerts & 2D/3D Skeletons using a single-camera OMS. 

We're mostly assisting with multimodal data visualisation at scale (billions) & dimensionality reduction for feature engineering, edge case mining & model eval for decision threshold tuning and annotation workflow orchestration as the team size grows or as they expand into more complex modalities like video or audio. 

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: {Invitation} Physical AI Webinar
text:
Hi [NAME],​

The Encord ML team are hosting a webinar on May 22nd that I think you'll find particularly relevant.

We'll be diving into some of the latest breakthroughs in World Models - like NVIDIA's GR00T N1 and Dreamer - and how they're paving the way for machines to truly understand and act in complex, real-world environments.

Here's a quick look at what we'll cover:
How World Models can unlock richer, more reliable real-world interactions Methods for spotting and correcting edge cases in huge sensor datasets A faster way to build clean, VLA-aligned datasets for deployment If you are up for it, you can register here: [LINK]

Would be great to see you there.

subject: [Invite] AI/ML Leaders Dinner - 29 May @ Aerlume Seattle
text:
Hi [NAME],

Impressive to see [COMPANY]'s recent milestone integrating autonomous
ground vehicles with UAS-capable payloads in the joint breaching
experiment. So wante to invite you to an intimate dinner our co-founders,
[SENDER] & [SENDER], are hosting in Seattle for a small group of AI leaders-let us
know if you're interested and able to join?

We've booked a private dinning room at Aerlume Seattle on Thursday, May
29th, 6:30-9:30 pm, capping attendance at 30 people. Attendees include
customers and other founders & technical leaders from leading AI/ML
VC-backed scale-ups working on autonomous vehicles - i.e. Skydio, Woven by
Toyota, Nexar, Allen Control Systems.

Bit of context on Encord...we're a computer vision scale-up (recently
raised a $30M Series B) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation,
workflow management and model evaluation under one platform.

Let me know if you're interested/free - happy to send over the full details.

text:
